## Summary

All three "needs Livewire setup / requires server / template issues" claims were **misdiagnoses**. Fixed in worktree:

| Test | Diagnosis | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `TwoFactorAuthTest::test_successful_login_records_activity` | Login is a Volt component; standard Volt component testing works. | Replaced the skip with `Volt::test('pages.auth.login')->set(...)->call('login')->assertHasNoErrors()` + DB assertion → **PASS (2 assertions)** |
| `TransactionControllerExtTest::test_edit_shows_edit_form` | Test was already passing 4 assertions; the "template issues" were a `risky` warning for leaked output buffers — and *every other view-rendering test in the file has the same warning*. | Removed the `markTestSkipped` line → **PASS (4 assertions, same risky status as siblings)** |
| `HolidaysSyncApiTest::test_artisan_command_can_trigger_holidays_sync` | Artisan command calls its own API via `Http::post()`. Laravel ships `Http::fake()` for exactly this. | Replaced commented body with `Http::fake([...])` + `Http::assertSent(...)` → **PASS (2 assertions)** |

Also reconciled the `incomplete` / `needs-data-refactor` docs:
- `CLAUDE.md` — dropped the misleading `--exclude-group=incomplete,needs-data-refactor` example; clarified that the groups have no members.
- `phpunit.xml` — left the `<group>incomplete</group>` scaffolding in place (harmless).

Memory updates:
- `feedback_test_run_uses_worktree.md` — never `docker exec app1-familyfund-1` for worktree code; lease a testpool slot instead. (Your callout earlier.)
- `project_test_exclude_groups_empty.md` — groups are no-ops; fix skips, don't tag them.

Test pool slot `test1` released.

Running the close-thread workflow.

0 commits ahead of main; 4 modified files unstaged. Nothing surprising — no env/pool artifacts.

## Phase 2 — Test gate

I ran each fixed test individually on `test1` slot (worktree-mounted): all three passed. I also ran the full `TransactionControllerExtTest` filter (34 tests, 26 ✓ + 8 risky, 0 failures). I have **not** run the rest of the suite (`Feature/`, `APIs/`, `Repositories/`, `GoldenData/`) against these changes.

The risk surface is narrow: the only changes outside the three test files are doc-only (`CLAUDE.md`). The three test edits add new green tests / unskip a green test — they can't regress other tests. But the user-requested test-gate guidance is to be explicit.
